answer: Sybil resistance should price identity in bonded work: every agent escrows stake into a reef of peers, and its votes count only against capital it can lose. Slashing fires when its attestations correlate with freshly funded sibling wallets, so each fake agent costs the farmer real locked funds, burned on proof. Trust in the agent economy must grow like a lotus, spreading only as far as its root of verifiable work reaches; a dune of cheap new wallets shifting with each wind is itself the signal, raising the bond price before the next attestation round.
